notes.title: New Game Mode - Dribble your Eggz
notes.notes:
New game mode added.
Now you can choose if you want to idle click the eggz like always or dribble it.
As much more dribble you do, as much more rare will be the skin dropped, but make sure to do at least 100 dribbles.

notes.title: Glass Eggz Released
notes.notes:
Now you can find glass eggs in your Steam inventory drop! 
Don't wait, start clicking to collect them all!

notes.title: Drop System Update
notes.notes:
New Drop System!
100 click to open the egg, 3 types of drop:

- it can be empty
- it can drop eggz in game skin (not marketable)
- rarely can drop eggz skin in steam inventory (marketable), look for [INV] prefix on drop history.

*Added lucky system, more empty eggz more lucky you will be!!

Faster drop system compared to similar other games!
